exampleEn: It's time to spark up a conversation with new people at the party.
exampleKo: 파티에서 새로운 사람들과 대화를 시작할 시간이에요.
gameExamples: She decided to spark up a discussion about their favorite books.
To break the ice, he tried to spark up a lighthearted joke.
During the meeting, it’s important to spark up some new ideas.
